project_type: Pure static HTML website (no build system). Bilingual Marathi/English government ashram school exam papers for Computer & AI, grades 1 to 10.
language: HTML + inline CSS; content data also mirrored in Markdown files.
build_system: None. No package.json, no bundler, no dev server. Files are served as-is from repo root.
test_framework: None. Verification is by HTML structure inspection and validity, plus internal consistency cross-checks between the HTML papers, the Markdown papers, and the answer key.
build_command: N/A (no build). Optional syntax sanity check: python3 -c "import html.parser, pathlib; ..." or open index.html in a browser.
test_command: N/A. Use consistency checks: verify option label sequences (A/B/C/D or [A]/[B]/[C]) are sequential per question, and that the AI answer key positions match the displayed AI HTML/MD option order.
verification_instructions: 1) Confirm every options-list / options-grid block still has sequential labels starting at A (or [A]) with no gaps or duplicates. 2) Confirm each correct answer's TEXT still exists exactly once per question (only its position moved). 3) For the AI paper, confirm AI_Exam_Model_Answer_Key.md letters now match the shuffled positions in BOTH AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html and AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md. 4) Confirm the per-paper A/B/C/D distribution of correct answers is spread out (not all A) and not a trivially guessable repeating pattern. 5) Confirm index.html Std-1 and Std-2 stay consistent with the same papers in Computer_Std_1_to_10_Question_Papers.md. 6) Open index.html and AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html in a browser (or inspect) to confirm no markup breakage.
setup_instructions: No dependencies to install. git checkout origin/main and create a fresh branch off it (do NOT branch off add-vercel-deploy). Edit files directly.
environment_constraints: No external network/service auth required. The current checkout is on branch add-vercel-deploy (an unrelated Vercel PR). This task's work MUST be based on origin/main so the two changes stay independent. Do NOT push or open a PR; the orchestrator publishes.
contribution_requirements: Preserve ALL Marathi/English bilingual text, HTML structure, CSS classes (options-list, option-item, checkbox-box, options-grid, opt-item, opt-check, match-grid, match-table, ans-inputs, match-ans-box), and styling exactly. Only option ORDER, option LABELS (re-lettered), match column-B ordering, and recorded answer-key letters may change. Never change WHICH answer is correct, only its position.
